Alex —

Thanks for taking the quick sync last week. Brightly Health looks like a strong fit for an AWS co-sell engagement; they’re evaluating vendor options for inference hosting and marketplace procurement. Can you introduce me to the Brightly contact and loop in the Partner Manager on the AWS side?

- Customer goals & timing (procurement windows)
- Roles: AWS, Redwood, Brightly
- Next steps: mutual action plan + SOW cadence

I’ll draft a one-page MAP and propose two meeting windows. Copying Vivek to help scope technical attendees.

Thanks,
